ownerDecision: Owner chose option B on 2026-10-26 (docs/DIFFICULTY_LANE_CALIBRATION_PROPOSAL_V1.md, SB-M36-012): score model v2 resumes M53-C003 from the frozen M53-C002 candidate; weights stay owner-locked (CLAUDE.md 11.3).
supersedesNothing: v1 (difficulty_score_model_v1.json, level_difficulty_analysis_v1.json, level_difficulty_analyzer_v1.gd) and the M53-C002 candidate stay byte-identical for provenance. v2 is the active model for NEW analysis only; every analysed level stores its model version.

workload.note: Cell workload is compressed so board size cannot dominate Challenge Score; heavy large boards are primarily controlled by Session Load.

accessibilityScarcity.definition: demand-relative: per decision state 1 - sum min(reachable, need) / sum need, need = min(raw ACTIVE of the colour, robots demanded); progress-interval weighted (see level_difficulty_analysis_v2.json operationalDefinitions.A)

unlockDepth.normalization: colour-aware unlock waves, corpus anchors U_p95_hi / U_mean_hi (level_difficulty_analysis_v2.json calibratedAnchors)

bottleneckPressure.consideredStates: only decision states with >= 2 legal fronts

routeComplexity.normalization: linear [lo, hi] corpus anchors R_len / R_detour / R_turn (level_difficulty_analysis_v2.json calibratedAnchors)

slotColorPressure.colorDemandImbalance: remaining-work imbalance: 1 - normalized Shannon entropy of the remaining ACTIVE counts of the demanded colours

changes.before: v1: every component measured on one oracle/solver trace (SolvabilitySolver path)
changes.after: mean over a six-policy non-oracle ensemble (RR, RR_REV, GREEDY, GREEDY_HI, ACCESS, ACCESS_HI) replayed through the real ProofKernel; the solver stays solvability authority only
changes.reason: the oracle path is the solver's search order, not what a player does; C002 corpus showed the mean over three policy families stays within the 1.75 D tie-break tolerance

changes.before: colour-agnostic peel waves normalised by the 59x59 envelope peel depth (unlockReferenceWave 29)
changes.after: colour-aware unlock waves under production access with same-colour closure; p95/mean normalised by corpus anchors U_p95_hi 4.0 / U_mean_hi 1.528
changes.reason: diagnosis 2.2: v1 U is pure board geometry (every full 32x32 board scores U 0.410); colour-aware U varies 0.27..0.97 across the seven 32x32 levels

changes.before: 1 - reachable/raw over all ACTIVE cells of each colour
changes.after: demand-relative 1 - sum min(reachable, need)/sum need, need = min(raw, robots demanded); linear corpus anchors A_lo 0.029 / A_hi 0.587
changes.reason: diagnosis 2.2: v1 A saturates at 0.61..0.78 on any filled art and is ordinally inverted on the corpus (comb/maze/mosaic below halves/stripes); corpus re-check: the declared A pair (shafts > band) passes, no inversion, so no further change

changes.before: all decision states; low-choice = <= lowChoiceThreshold (2) productive fronts
changes.after: only states with >= 2 legal fronts; low-choice = <= 2 productive AND fewer productive than legal
changes.reason: diagnosis 2.2: with 3 supply columns '<= 2 productive' was true at 65..100% of states; column exhaustion is not a bottleneck. Saturation re-check: considered-state low-choice fraction is 0..0.16 on the corpus and 0..0.32 on L2..L10, so the threshold is not made relative (no saturation remains; with 3 columns the 'fewer than legal' condition already makes it relative)

changes.before: singleProductive over all states; imbalance = robot-weighted front shortfall clamp(1 - reachable/robots)
changes.after: single-colour term only over states demanding >= 2 colours; imbalance = remaining-work imbalance across demanded colours (docs/09 4.7)
changes.reason: diagnosis 2.2: interleaved single-colour EASY supplies drove v1 S high (rho -0.64 vs lane target); the shortfall term also double-counted A. v2 S on EASY L2/L4/L6 is 0.03..0.06

changes.before: length/diagonal, detour, turns on the oracle trace, Stage-A anchors
changes.after: same three measures over the ensemble, linear corpus anchors (FLOW_SIZE median lo, corpus max hi)
changes.reason: v1 R was flat (0.8 D spread); only the anchors move to the independent corpus, definition unchanged
diagnosis 2.2: behaves as designed; corpus flow-size family spread 5.5 D < 18
diagnosis 2.2: the one component tracking the cadence (rho +0.72); corpus colour pairs pass
